text:
Mia: Heads-up: Appliance partner Nexus launching next month. They want private offers in marketplace + co-sell credits for SI integrators. We need guardrails so ops/finance don't get surprised.

Carlos: I'm volunteer for pricing draft. Thinking smaller granularity: four commit bands instead of three so field can price for mid-range customers.

Lina: Ops: separate SKUs per deployment (hosted/dedicated/private) please. Also need a mapping table to avoid billing ambiguity.

Devon: Sales: we need clear per-account caps and a definition of what counts as "co-sell activity" for credit eligibility. Otherwise renewals get messy.

Priya: Legal: we also need transferability rules and a firm expiration on onboarding credits. Suggested: credits expire 6 months after issue, non-transferable, not redeemable for cash.

Carlos: Draft bands below (numbers are rough, will run with finance):

```
Band 1 	6k commit/year -> 5% discount + $5k onboarding credit, 6-month term
Band 2 50k commit/year -> 12% discount + $12k onboarding credit, 12-month term
Band 3 50k commit/year -> 18% discount + $25k onboarding credit, 12-month term
Band 4 00k+ commit/year -> 28% discount + $50k onboarding credit + prioritized support, 12/24 options
```

Devon: For renewals propose: standard renewal = same discount; if customer increases commit by >=20% -> bonus 3% credit on next term. Also propose early-convert credit: convert pilot to paid within 45 days = extra $3k credit.

Priya: Legal ok to add early-convert but will limit to first-time customers only. Need to capture in PO: "early-convert credit applies once per customer".

Lina: Ops note: prioritized support (Band 4) requires SLA mapping to a Dedicated pool. That has infra cost implications. Need to confirm capacity.

Mia: Finance: call out on caps. Carlos, can you add a per-account soft cap on co-sell credits? Suggest $40k max unless exec sign-off.

Carlos: Agree. Add soft cap $40k per account. Also propose a per-deal cap: 30% of committed value.

Devon: Can we add an internal approval step if credits exceed $25k per deal? Field needs quick turn.

Priya: Legal prefers approvals logged in portal. We'll add a checklist item in Marketplace PR flow for credit approvals.

partner-bot: Nexus partner requested co-branded announcement and 72-hr pre-notification for public comms. Link: https://nexus.example/comms-draft

Mia: 72 hrs is ok. Add a mutual review window (48 business hours) for joint press. No unilateral publishes.

Carlos: I'll run sensitivity to check ROI with those onboarding credits and the per-deal caps. Will share numbers by Wednesday.

Lina: Timeline: if we lock numbers this Thursday, ops can push listings Friday and QA next week. Marketplace sync will need a SKU CSV.

Devon: Field enablement: I'll prepare two playbooks: SI motion (how to qualify co-sell) and Renewal motion (scripts + checklist).

Priya: Also flag export controls for private/on-prem customers. If hardware requires air-gapped installs, add compliance clause.

Mia: Good catch. Add compliance flag to the PO templates.

Carlos: One more ask from Nexus: they want a performance milestone (joint case study) at 90 days to unlock an extra $10k marketing fund. Thoughts?

Devon: Case study milestone is fine but define "success metrics" up front. Suggest usage >50% of committed capacity + customer quote.

Priya: Legal: add an approval window for case study content and a mutual kill switch clause.

Mia: Ok. Summary of action items: Carlos -> run finance model + add caps; Priya -> PO clauses for credits, expiry, transferability, export control; Lina -> SKU CSV template + infra capacity check for Band 4; Devon -> enablement playbooks + case study metrics; partner-bot -> post Nexus comms link to partner channel.

partner-bot: Reminder set: follow-up Thursday 09:00 PT.

Mia: If anyone sees competing numbers elsewhere, call me out. We're the source of truth here. :eyes: 

Carlos: Will post updated bands by Wed afternoon.

Devon: +1

Priya: +1

Lina: +1

partner-bot: Thread archived by Mia.
